accessibility.description: Bazaar Access adds keyboard navigation and screen-reader output through Tolk, including combat announcements, tutorial support and account interfaces. Requires the Steam PC edition and BepInEx, included in the full mod download. Accessibility is a work in progress and complete coverage has not been independently established. The cited release has human-checked English and Spanish translations; other translations may be less reliable.
